name: unigig
description: unigig — student freelance marketplace (monorepo: client + server)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate:deploy -w server && concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm:dev -w server" "npm:dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec server npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
